as_of.description: When the latest sample in the window was taken (Unix seconds).

days_until_threshold.description:
Days from `now` until free space drops below the reserve (`Filling`; 0 for
`BelowReserve`).

fill_bytes_per_day.description:
Free space lost per day by the trend (negative when free space grows). Present once
there is enough history.

free_bytes.description: Latest free space, plus releases recorded after that sample (bytes).

jumps_ignored.description:
Steps levelled out of the trend: known releases plus detected cleanups and one-off
drops.

noise_ratio.description:
Residual spread relative to the change the trend explains over the span (lower is
steadier).

reserve_bytes.description: The reserve the forecast counts down to (bytes).

span_secs.description: Seconds between the first and the latest sample in the window.

threshold_at.description: When free space is forecast to drop below the reserve (Unix seconds).

total_bytes.description: Volume size at the latest sample (bytes).

volume_id.description: Volume identifier, as recorded in history (mount point or volume GUID path).

ForecastConfidence.description: How much to trust a forecast. Ordered: `Unknown < Low < Medium < High`.

oneOf.description: Not enough history to say anything.
Short history, noisy data or a long extrapolation; not shown in status lines.
Shown in status lines and may alert.
Long, regular history and a short extrapolation.
Too few samples or too short a span in the window; no extrapolation.
Free space is stable or growing, or would take longer than the horizon to run out.
Free space is already at or below the reserve (measured, not forecast).
The database answered (the series may still be empty).
No database yet (nothing was ever recorded, or history is off).
The database can't be read right now (`detail` says why).

alert_days.description: Forecasts are shown as alerts within this many days (`[proactive] alert_days`).

detail.description: Why it didn't, when it didn't.

forecasts.description: One per sampled volume, sorted by volume ID.

reserve_bytes.description: The reserve every forecast counts down to (bytes; `[proactive] reserve_gib`).
